verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs say the REST API gives 'programmatic control over the entire platform' and that the CLI and SDK are built on it. They also state directly that 'anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.' A live OpenAPI spec, the official CLI/SDK repo, and scoped API keys back up the parity claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI parity, and evidence that account signup, billing top-up and team creation work through the API (the docs only describe these through the web UI).
